name: camayoc_ex_symbols_in_module
description: The code symbols a module defines (bobbin:definedIn), with their kind.
template: PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX bobbin: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> SELECT ?symbol ?name ?kind WHERE { ?symbol a bobbin:CodeSymbol ; bobbin:definedIn <{module}> ; bobbin:name ?name . OPTIONAL { ?symbol bobbin:symbolKind ?kind } } ORDER BY ?name
